shellCommands.command: git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -200 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null
ls -la && cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore && ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -50; node -v; npm -v; npm config get registry; timeout 20 npm view marked version 2>&1 | tail -2

ls node_modules/@uiw node_modules | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -n '"node_modules/@uiw\|"node_modules/marked\|"node_modules/react-markdown' package-lock.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

timeout 60 npm view react-markdown version peerDependencies 2>/dev/null; timeout 60 npm view remark-gfm version 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep -n '"main"\|"types"\|"module"' ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -80

timeout 300 npm install react-markdown@^10.1.0 remark-gfm@^4.0.1 2>&1 | tail -5 && git diff --stat && cat package.json | sed -n '/dependencies/,/}/p' && npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -5; echo tsc=$?

git diff package.json | head -30; D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $D/components/controls/TextArea/TextArea.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls $D/components/controls | head -30; grep -o '\-\-g-color-text-[a-z-]*' $D/components/variables.css 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head; grep -rho '\-\-g-color-[a-z-]*' $D/../../styles/*.css 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles 2>/dev/null
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn'; echo tsc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -15

for v in g-text-subheader-1-font g-text-body-1-font g-font-family-monospace g-color-text-link g-color-text-hint g-border-radius-m g-color-line-generic-hover g-color-text-secondary g-color-base-neutral-light g-color-base-background; do printf "%s: " $v; grep -rl -- "--$v:" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/ 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true; echo; done; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i playwright

grep -o -- '--g-font-family-monospace[^;]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -2; grep -o -- '--g-color-text-hint:[^;]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -1; grep -o -- '--g-color-text-primary:[^;]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -1; ls ~/.cache 2>/dev/null; timeout 30 npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1 | tail -1

mkdir -p /tmp/mdcheck && cat > /tmp/mdcheck/check.mjs <<'EOF' import { createElement as h } from '/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/react/index.js'; import { renderToStaticMarkup } from '/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/react-dom/server.js'; import ReactMarkdown from '/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/react-markdown/index.js'; import remarkGfm from '/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/remark-gfm/index.js'; const src = [ '# Заголовок', '', 'Текст с **жирным**, *курсивом*, ~~зачёркнутым~~ и `кодом`.', '', '- [x] готово', '- [ ] нет', '', '| a | b |', '|---|---|', '| 1 | 2 |', '', '[bad](javascript:alert(1))', '[good](https://example.com)', '', '', '', '', ].join('\n'); console.log(renderToStaticMarkup(h(ReactMarkdown, { remarkPlugins: [remarkGfm] }, src))); EOF cd /tmp/mdcheck && node check.mjs
